name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: Your next days of events with the current one tagged: join the call, open it in Calendar, copy its details, delete it; a form adds one. EventKit on macOS, khal on Linux.
author: pal

settings.label: Calendars
settings.description: Calendar names (or ids) to show; empty shows every calendar. The filter dropdown narrows further.

settings.label: Days ahead
settings.description: How many days from today to list.

store.tagline: Your next days of events, one key to join the call
features: Today, Tomorrow, This week and Later as sections; the current event tagged `now`, the next one `in 12 min`
Every account Calendar.app has (iCloud, Google, Exchange) through EventKit on macOS; `khal` on Linux
`enter` joins the call when the event has a Zoom, Meet, Teams or Webex link (found in the url, the location or the notes, Outlook safelinks unwrapped), else opens it in Calendar
The calendar's colour as the row's dot, the head count and a `Join` tag on the right; a filter per calendar
The detail pane: the notes as markdown, when, where, the organizer, every attendee with their reply, whether it repeats
New event as a form: title, a day in words (`fri`, `next mon`, `20 sep`), start and end, all-day, the calendar, a location, notes
Delete an event, or one occurrence of a repeating one, after a confirmation
Live with a 60 s ttl: the list is fresh on every show without re-reading the store more than once a minute

screenshots.caption: Today and the days after, the running event tagged now, calls tagged Join

actions.title: Join call
actions.description: Opens the meeting link; first when the event has one.

actions.title: Copy event details
actions.description: Title, when, where and the link as text.

actions.title: Delete event
actions.description: Asks first; on a repeating event only this occurrence goes (macOS).

actions.title: New event
actions.description: The form, then the event in the chosen calendar.

actions.title: Grant access
actions.description: On the permission row: the system prompt, or System Settings when it was denied.

schedule.title: My Schedule
schedule.description: The next days' events in time order, sectioned by day, the current or next one tagged; a New event row at the end.

keys.title: Join the call, else open in Calendar
